12 month projection · Aug 2026 to Jul 2027

352 certificates

The shape behind the numbers

Keystone campaign, to existing practitioners

We have a reachable database of over 2,000 existing practitioners, trained since 2016 and contactable by email and social.

In August we send that group the Keystone update. Everyone who takes it earns a new certificate. We expect about 250 to take it, around 12% of the people we can reach.

Most come early: 80 in the first month, then fewer each month, until it runs out in February.

Past refreshes have followed the same shape, and this is by far the most significant update we have offered existing practitioners.

That part only happens once. A practitioner can only be introduced to Keystone once, so the spike cannot repeat.

Campaign to the new audience

From November we turn to new people. They meet us at a free training introduction, and that is where the training is taken up.

Past trends give us the rate: around 70% of the people who attend a free training introduction go on to train. So the work is filling the sessions, not winning the room over.

On that basis new certificates climb from 4 in November to 15 a month by April.

When the launch is done, that is what is left: about 15 new certificates a month, near enough 180 a year, and that carries on.

This is also where the effort steps up. We are putting marketing behind the new audience using methods we have not run before, so we treat 15 a month as a floor, not a ceiling.

So read it this way. 352 is the launch year. 15 a month is the business.

These are projections, not promises. They are built on how our past launches actually went, and they assume nobody drops off, so treat them as the good case.
